scope: Repository-local declared scenario evidence, not exhaustive invariant conformance. Uncovered means no reviewed test binding is declared here, not that no relevant test exists.
verification_limit: The checker verifies definition IDs and named test declarations, not whether a test semantically establishes an invariant. It does not execute tests, prove reachability or physical safety, or evaluate the rationale.
source_limit: IDs come from local vendored documents. cell_operations/v1.0/05_validation_audit.md is outside the four normative-document hashes and can drift independently between repositories.

invariants.reason: No end-to-end binding is declared that jointly observes the preceding platform intent commit and Host SEND_ENTERED for a normal native effect.
No reviewed Host test is declared for the complete scope/key-to-immutable-intent-and-operation identity boundary; journal replay is recorded separately.
Host native-journal and PLC transport reply-loss scenarios; not every device backend.

tests.name: native_journal_prevents_resend_and_new_id_bypass_after_reply_loss_and_reopen
tests.reason: Loses a native reply, retries across reopen and tries new IDs; sent count stays one and pending lookup remains unknown until correlated success arrives.

tests.name: lost_write_response_preserves_uncertainty_and_never_resends
tests.reason: After one PLC write with a lost response, marks ExchangeEntered uncertainty, faults further IO and asserts exactly one effect; this is driver evidence alongside the Host journal test.

invariants.reason: No binding is declared for the full completion-evidence rule versus timeout, idle and BT-only success; reviewed domain/native-result tests are narrower.
One simulator device has one independent owner; real hardware and multi-controller allocation are not established.

tests.name: simulated_device_has_an_independent_exclusive_owner
tests.reason: A second FileDevice open on the same directory returns Busy until the first owner is dropped.

invariants.reason: No reviewed binding is declared for rejection of samples from restarted or expired control-stream sessions.
No binding is declared for the complete atomic bundle of decision inputs, outcome, events and revisions. Reviewed T2 replay tests alone are not that complete assertion.

The reviewed JTC test separates terminal completion from safe adapter shutdown, but does not assert platform resource disposition or RELEASED. It remains adjacent shutdown evidence, not a declared resource-release trace.
No binding is declared for combined gap, reboot and time-uncertainty reporting; evaluator freshness cases alone do not establish that reporting boundary.
Simulation catalog declaration versus physical profile admission; not a physical commissioning test.

tests.name: simulation_fixture_profile_cannot_claim_physical_equipment
tests.reason: The same catalog fixture validates in Simulation and is rejected after changing only its environment to Physical.

invariants.reason: No reviewed binding jointly connects UI, BT and native-return paths to the authoritative platform conclusion ledger.
The reviewed blocked-gate StoreFault callback test is adjacent; it does not inject failed persistence and establish the whole protective-reaction exception. No binding is declared.
No reviewed binding is declared for all admitted-operation envelope, qualification, dependency and current-scope identities together.
No reviewed Host binding is declared for required-condition UNKNOWN and unknown-schema handling; platform evaluator tests belong to the other repository.
No binding is declared for production, setup and recovery writes with all corresponding cell-aware purpose/parent checks.
No reviewed Host binding is declared for mandate revocation versus clearing a transient normal wait.
No Host binding is declared for all pending StartAttempt, Arm and clearance non-authority boundaries; the platform map separately records a partial-Arm scenario.
Host purpose/content binding and expiry at the send boundary; not every permit field or purpose.

tests.name: altered_permit_and_unapproved_intent_are_rejected_before_effect
tests.reason: Changes permit purpose to Setup or changes the intent target and asserts rejection with no simulated native effects.

tests.name: expiry_during_commit_does_not_enter_native_and_is_not_retried
tests.reason: Expires authorization after its commit, retains SEND_ENTERED, and asserts both the first attempt and retry produce zero native effects.

invariants.reason: Single-device ownership and shutdown tests do not stage two support-reducing operations on one material with reciprocal support PASS. No material-support conflict binding is declared.
No reviewed binding is declared for production restart while retaining every related case, person and external restriction.
No reviewed binding spans acknowledgement, reset observation, work completion, revalidation and explicit new start as distinct actions.
No reviewed binding is declared for the complete change-to-condition/qualification/clearance invalidation and new-epoch synchronization chain.
Host SIGKILL/recovery and metadata-authority restoration only; controller, platform and executor backup rollback remain undeclared.

tests.name: sigkill_at_both_journal_native_boundaries_never_replays_device_effect
tests.reason: Kills the Host child before or after native entry, recovers it, and checks effect counts stay respectively zero or one.

tests.name: qualification_commit_survives_sigkill_before_reply_without_restoring_authority
tests.reason: Recovers an accepted qualification receipt after SIGKILL but asserts activation_authorized=false and that the receipt is not current for the Host.

invariants.reason: No reviewed binding establishes the prohibition on inferring actual safety-function performance from epistemic consistency, GOOD data or UI display.
No reviewed binding is declared for control-stream session/epoch/sequence checks together with actual native-application ordering.
Calling a StoreFault protection callback while the gate is busy is adjacent evidence, not an injected DB/communication failure test of the complete reaction obligation. No binding is declared.
No solutions-local budget binding is declared; platform budget tests are represented only in the platform map.
Physical metadata and fixture declarations do not themselves authorize Host activity; tests use simulation/loopback only.

tests.name: physical_startup_qualification_id_does_not_authorize_arm
tests.reason: Loads a Physical metadata fixture with a startup qualification ID, then asserts Arm rejection and zero PLC reads/writes.

tests.name: late_fence_replay_cannot_remove_a_new_arm_or_rewind_epoch
